Privacy

Updated September 30, 2026.

Quiz answers

Your budget, recipient, age band, interests, and gift-style answers stay in the page’s memory. This version does not send those answers to a server, store them in a database, or save them in cookies or browser storage. Reloading the page resets them.

Accounts and analytics

This site does not offer visitor accounts, collect email addresses, or run a separate visitor analytics service. Google’s AdSense script may process information as described below. The hosting provider may process ordinary request information to deliver and secure the website under its own privacy practices.

Amazon shopping links

Shopping links lead to Amazon and include an affiliate tracking ID. Clicking a link sends you to Amazon, which may use cookies and process your activity under its own policies. Couple Better Gifts does not receive your Amazon payment details or your quiz answers through these links.

Read Amazon’s Privacy Notice and OpenAI’s Privacy Policy for the hosting provider.

Advertising

This site loads Google’s AdSense script and requests a responsive display ad after you dismiss the gift quiz’s welcome screen. Ad availability depends on Google’s approval, advertising demand, and your browser settings. The welcome button acknowledges the instructions; it is not a choice about advertising cookies.

Google and other third-party advertising vendors use cookies to tailor advertising based on visits to this and other websites. Google’s advertising cookies allow it and its partners to show ads based on browsing activity. Third-party advertising partners may also use cookies under their own policies.

You can manage personalized advertising at Google My Ad Center, learn about Google’s use of information from partner sites, and review other vendors’ choices at YourAdChoices. Browser settings can also control cookies. Applicable consent settings will need to be configured before serving ads to visitors in regions that require them.

Changes

The date above identifies the current notice. Review this page when the site adds features.
